verdict.rationale: Pilot advertises an in-app AI feature giving 'instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow' and cash-flow affordability scenarios (e.g., 'Know if you can afford new hires'), which matches the spirit of the story, but this is framed as a built-in chat feature, not something exposed via a documented API for an external ai-native agent to query. Probes show no OpenAPI/Swagger spec or API docs (all 404), so there's no evidence an agent could pull live ledger data through Pilot's API. Missing for 10: a public/documented API or MCP-style integration allowing external agents to query live ledger data, and any confirmation the in-app AI assistant is API-accessible rather than UI-only.
